// diagnostic

E0426

`` `#Uninit` is retired ``.

What

`` `#Uninit` is retired ``.

Why

Uninitialized storage is a fact about the value — it now reads `` `name := Type{ uninit }` ``.

Fix

Write `` `{name} := <Type>{ uninit }` ``.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0426: tests/ui/uninit_marker_retired.stderr.

Error [E0426]: `#Uninit` is retired
  --> tests/ui/uninit_marker_retired.jet:6:5
    |
  6 |     #Uninit x: Int
    |     ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: uninitialized storage is a fact about the value — it now reads `name := Type{ uninit }`
 Fix: write `x := <Type>.{ uninit }`
